comments.text_zh: 我同意你的看法。这篇文章还提到，他们把重点放在脂肪/饱和脂肪上；这也是一个很糟糕的重点。真正的危险不是脂肪，甚至不是饱和脂肪/反式脂肪，而是淀粉和糖。婴儿配方奶粉这类产品中这类碳水化合物的增加，实际上正在导致婴儿肥胖！过量的糖会给动脉造成压力并损伤动脉。胆固醇是由脂质（LDLs 和 HDLs，它们实际上不是胆固醇，而是把胆固醇运送到全身血液中的蛋白质）运送到这些动脉的。如果你吃很多糖，当动脉修复损伤时，胆固醇就可能在动脉壁之间堆积。它们最终可能破坏血管壁，把斑块释放到血液中，并可能引发心脏并发症。我强烈推荐看 Dr. Lustig 的视频（UCTV）了解更多：[VIDEO] 几年前我改用 keto 正常脂肪/极低碳水（不含纤维）饮食。我减了重，更有精力，也感觉好多了。当然，这并不适合所有人。有些人的体型适合更高的碳水摄入（我认识一个跑步者，他每周吃 30 根香蕉），而且和往常一样，在 drastically 改变饮食之前，要做研究，咨询你的医生、营养师等。一个常见的迷思是 Adkins 死于他自己的饮食。他没有，而 Reuters 还重新刊发专栏暗示他就是如此。我真想知道，如果世界没有否定他的想法，或者没有否定许多营养学家数十年来的想法，今天的肥胖流行病会不会已经减轻了
comments.text: I agree with you. This article also mentions they're focusing on fats/saturated fats; which is also a terrible focus. The real danger is not fat, even saturated/trans-fats, but starches and sugar. The increase in these types of carbohydrates in products like baby formula is actually leading to obesity in infants! Excess sugar can stress arteries and damage them. Cholesterol is carried to these artier by lipids (LDLs and HDLs, which are not actually cholesterol, but proteins that carry it through your bloodstream). If you eat a lot of sugar, cholesterol can build up between the walls of arteries as they fix the damage. They can eventually break down the wall, releasing plaque into the bloodstream and potentially causing heart complications. I highly recommend Dr. Lustig's video (UCTV) to learn more: [VIDEO] A few years back I switched to a keto normal fat/very low carb (excluding fiber) diet. I've lost weight, gained energy and have felt a lot better. Of course this isn't for everyone. Some people have a body type that lends itself to higher carb intake (I knew a runner who'd eat 30 bananas a week) and as always do your research, consult with your doctor, dietitian, etc. before drastic changes in your diet. It's a common myth that Adkins died of his own diet. He didn't, and Reuters rededicated their column implying that he did. I honestly wonder if the obesity epidemic would have gone down today if the world didn't dismiss his ideas, or the ideas of many nutritionist for decad

comments.why_zh: 详细解释果糖与葡萄糖代谢差异
comments.quote_zh: 其中大部分内容并无争议。
comments.text_zh: 这几乎是对的，但仍然危险地错了。果糖和葡萄糖非常不同，一种永远不会转化成另一种。所有细胞都能且会摄取并代谢葡萄糖，但只有肝脏能输入并代谢果糖。在代谢上，果糖不像碳水化合物，而像酒精。胰岛素主要影响脂肪、肌肉和肝脏细胞。它们通过储存多余的葡萄糖来反应，而且这样做是无害的。过量的葡萄糖不会导致胰岛素耐受；果糖似乎会，不过我不记得完整机制。几丁质和木质素都不是碳水化合物，木质素甚至在化学上都不相关。即使是反刍动物也不能消化木质素，只有少数真菌能做到。总之，底线是果糖是个问题，葡萄糖不是，而把两者都归到“碳水”下会混淆问题。详见 [VIDEO] 了解大量细节。（但不要只看 Dr. Lustig 的说法——要查其他来源。其中大部分内容并无争议。）
comments.text: This is almost right, but still manages to be dangerously wrong. Frustose and glucose are very different, one never gets converted to the other. All cells can and will take up and metabolize glucose, but only the liver can import and metabolize fructose. Metabolically, fructose does not behave like a carbohydrate, but like alcohol. Insulin affects mostly fat, muscle and liver cells. They react by storing the excess glucose, which they do harmlessly. Excess glucose does not cause insulin tolerance; fructose seems to do that, thought I don't remember the whole mechanism. Neither chitin nor lignin are carbohydrates, lignin isn't even chemically related. Even ruminants can't digest lignin, only a few funghi can do that. At any rate, the bottom line is that frustose is a problem, glucose isn't, and lumping both under "carbs" confuses matters. See [VIDEO] for lots of details. (But don't take Dr. Lustig's words at face value---check other sources. Most of it is uncontroversial.)

comments.text_zh: 在儿科内分泌学家 Donald Lustig 那段被这里贴过无数次的抗糖视频里，他说 HFCS 并不比糖更糟——在如今人们摄入的量下，两者对你都很糟糕。这说得通，因为它们在化学上基本是同一回事（蔗糖是葡萄糖和果糖组成的二糖，而 HFCS 是葡萄糖和果糖单糖的混合物，比例可能因配方而略偏向果糖或葡萄糖。蔗糖的二糖在体内无论如何都会分解，所以最终没有临床显著差异。Lustig 不认为这种差异重要）。如果这里有什么误导之处，那就是人们认为“真正的”糖没问题。我猜它会让你得天然糖尿病。例行放上视频链接：[VIDEO]
comments.text: In the anti-sugar video by Donald Lustig, pediatric endocrinologist, that's been posted here a million times, he says HFCS is no worse than sugar - they're both terrible for you in the quantities people consume these days. This makes sense because they're chemically essentially the same thing (sucrose is a disaccharide of glucose and fructose, whereas HFCS is mix of glucose and fructose monosaccharides in proportions that may slightly skew towards fructose or glucose depending on the formulation. The disaccharides of sucrose are broken up in the body anyway, so in the end there's no clinically significant difference. Lustig didn't think the difference was important). If there's anything misleading going on here, it's that people think that "real" sugar is OK. I guess it'll give you natural diabetes. Obligatory link to the video: [VIDEO]

comments.text_zh: 过去几年有几部关于这个问题的纪录片：- 《Sugar Coated》（2015）- 《That Sugar Film》（2014）- 《Fed Up》（2014）这些电影中出现的一些权威人士包括：Robert Lustig——UCSF 的教授和儿科内分泌学家，公开反对在膳食中添加糖。见：[VIDEO] Gary Taubes——记者，著有《Good Calories, Bad Calories: Challenging the Conventional Wisdom on Diet, Weight Control, and Disease》和《Why We Get Fat: And What to Do About It》 Yoni Freedhoff——加拿大渥太华的医生，批评食品行业使用糖。见：[LINK] 看起来证据正在积累，很像当年针对烟草行业的案子。也许基于最近对可能救命研究的压制，会出现针对软饮料和加工食品公司的集体诉讼。
comments.text: There have been several documentaries about this issue in the past few years: - Sugar Coated (2015) - That Sugar Film (2014) - Fed Up (2014) Some of the authorities who are found in these movies are: Robert Lustig - Professor and pediatric endocrinologist at UCSF who speaks out against added dietary sugar. See: [VIDEO] Gary Taubes - journalist and author of Good Calories, Bad Calories: Challenging the Conventional Wisdom on Diet, Weight Control, and Disease and Why We Get Fat: And What to Do About It Yoni Freedhoff - Medical doctor from Ottawa, Canada who criticizes the food industry's use of sugar. See: [LINK] It seems like a case is building, much like the case against the tobacco industry. Maybe there will be class-action lawsuits against soft drink and processed food companies based on recent suppression of potentially life-saving research.

comments.why_zh: 为 Lustig 认为果糖像酒精一样有毒的论点提供出处
comments.quote_zh: 果糖由肝脏代谢[0]，方式与乙醇几乎一模一样。
comments.text_zh:
> 果糖通常被认为比蔗糖或葡萄糖更健康——也就是“天然果糖没问题”那套前提——但考虑到它吃下去后会被立即、轻易地转化为葡萄糖，这说法很可能站不住脚。

我不知道有什么论点说它有毒，或者说它在任何意义上比葡萄糖更糟。同样因为那个原因，这也不太可能成立——它会被立即转化为葡萄糖。果糖由肝脏代谢[0]，方式与乙醇几乎一模一样。这就是为什么 Robert Lustig（《Sugar: The Bitter Truth》[1] 那位）主张果糖是一种毒物，并应该像酒精一样征税。据我所知，它可以说是非酒精性脂肪肝的成因：[LINK]

你的评论在我看来混淆了几个因素……果糖并不会在吃下去后转化为葡萄糖。但类似的说法适用于蔗糖 vs. HFCS，使它们在摄入层面几乎相同（葡萄糖和果糖的拆分）。不过这和身体如何处理果糖是两回事。此外，被视为更健康的是完整的水果，因为膳食纤维，而不是因为果糖。果糖被吸收时，对肝脏来说始终是个麻烦。纤维的作用是减缓或阻止其吸收，最好的情况是让它到达大肠，在被身体吸收之前由肠道菌群转化为胀气。[0] [LINK] [1] [VIDEO]
comments.text: > Fructose is usually considered healthier than sucrose or glucose - the whole "natural fruit sugars are OK" premise - though that seems likely to be nonsense given it's immediately and easily converted to glucose after you eat it. I don't know of any argument that says it's poisonous, or in any sense worse than glucose. That also seems unlikely to be true for the same reason - it's immediately converted to glucose. Fructose is metabolized by the liver[0] ~identically to ethanol. This is why Robert Lustig (the Sugar: The Bitter Truth[1] dude) argues fructose is a poison, and taxing it like alcohol. AIUI it's arguably the cause of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: [LINK] Your comment strikes me as confusing several factors... fructose does not turn into glucose upon eating it. But something like that is applicable to Sucrose vs. HFCS, rendering them ~identical in consumption (a split of glucose and fructose). That's orthogonal to what the body does with the fructose though. Furthermore it's intact fruit that is seen as healthier because of the dietary fiber, not because of the fructose. The fructose is always a problem for the liver to deal with when absorbed. Fiber helps by slowing/preventing its absorption, in the best case letting it reach the large intestine to turn into flatulence via guttural flora before the body can absorb it.
